description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kumbuka, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530176
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and land title classifications. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights in specific locations, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4).
